description: test.md 'The units-file upgrade (9 → 11) on a real map': smoketest cliff.w3m (the editor's own save, units subversion 9, no 0x4000) with a tavern ntav of Neutral Passive at (1024, -512) (make-corpus-saves.mjs units9-cliff-tavern), box selected at the opening camera (it stands at 1188,578) and nudged once (KP_8): the editor's save sets w3i flag 0x4000 and writes the units file as subversion 11 (item tables -1, hero attributes 0); Studio's terrain-view save the same (tftflag.ts tftUnitsLayout, branch we-terrain-items). Branch we-batch-4, 2026-11-20

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.units?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); [...document.querySelectorAll('.terrain-tab')].find((b) => b.textContent === 'Select').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));
